newsitem.title: USA: Pogo pushes for production at Thai Benchamas.
newsitem.headline: Pogo pushes for production at Thai Benchamas.

text.p: Pogo Producing Co, declaring its latest five-well exploratory drilling program in the Gulf of Thailand's Benchamas area a success, said Thursday it has asked the Thai government for production licenses.
"These are five wells that add a lot of sexiness to the Benchamas structure," Pogo's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Paul Van Wagnen told Reuters in a telephone interview.

"Pogo and its joint venture partners already made formal application to the Thai government for a production license allowing development of the large and highly prospective Benchamas area," Van Wagnen said in a prepared statement.
